command: set -euo pipefail; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = '40eac7a504d363a05cd6c235c25146e01bb36ff2'; test -n "$(adb shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r')"; echo '--- SERVICE ---'; adb shell dumpsys activity services io.blueeye | grep -E 'ScannerService|isForeground|startRequested' || true; echo '--- UI ---'; adb shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/tracker-current.xml >/dev/null; adb shell cat /sdcard/tracker-current.xml | grep -oE 'text="[^"]*"|content-desc="[^"]*"' | grep -v '=""' | head -n 60; echo '--- LIFECYCLE ---'; adb logcat -d -v brief -s ScannerService:V BleScanner:V '*:S' | tail -n 120; echo '--- ERRORS ---'; PID=$(adb shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r'); adb logcat -d -v brief --pid="$PID" | grep -E 'FATAL EXCEPTION|AndroidRuntime|SecurityException|IllegalStateException|SQLiteException|OutOfMemoryError|Bluetooth is off or unavailable|SCANNER_FAILED|START_FAILED' || true
